title: Sam Altman says OpenAI is amending its DOD contract to ensure "the AI system" is not "intentionally used for domestic surveillance of US persons and nationals" (George Hammond/Financial Times)
summary: George Hammond / Financial Times: Sam Altman says OpenAI is amending its DOD contract to ensure “the AI system” is not “intentionally used for domestic surveillance of US persons and nationals” — Sam Altman says company is working with defence department on provisions covering mass surveillance
contentText:
George Hammond / Financial Times :

Sam Altman says OpenAI is amending its DOD contract to ensure “the AI system” is not “intentionally used for domestic surveillance of US persons and nationals”   —  Sam Altman says company is working with defence department on provisions covering mass surveillance
